enableYtdlpFallback.description: When the direct HTTP media download or Whisper transcription fails, try yt-dlp (requires ffmpeg). Off by default so runs stay fast, deterministic and HTTP-only.
enableYtdlpFallback.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
enableYtdlpFallback.title: Enable yt-dlp fallback

includeQuotedVideo.description: When a quote post has no video of its own, transcribe the video of the quoted post. The row keeps the quote post's metadata and records quotedTweetId.
includeQuotedVideo.title: Transcribe quoted video when the post has none

includeTweetMetadata.description: Attach the full post and author metadata (text, counts, bio, followers, quote/repost details) to every row.
includeTweetMetadata.title: Include post details

includeWordTimestamps.description: Add per-word start/end times to AI (Whisper) transcript segments. Automatically enabled when Segment granularity is Sentence or Word. Native captions only carry words when X included inline timing markers.
includeWordTimestamps.title: Include word timestamps

language.description: Optional language code, for example en, es, fr or ur. Native captions prefer this language when several tracks exist; AI transcription uses it as a spoken-language hint. Leave empty to detect automatically.
language.title: Spoken/caption language hint

maxDownloadMb.description: Largest media download allowed for AI transcription. The actor picks the audio-only or lowest-bitrate rendition first, then stops with a media_too_large status row if the limit is exceeded. Defaults to 200 MB.
maxDownloadMb.title: Max download size (MB)

maxDurationSeconds.description: Videos longer than this are skipped for AI transcription and get a media_too_large status row. Built-in captions are still returned when available. Defaults to 1200 seconds (20 minutes).
maxDurationSeconds.title: Max video duration (seconds)

maxVideosPerProfile.description: How many recent video posts to transcribe per profile input. Defaults to 10.
maxVideosPerProfile.title: Max video posts per profile

outputFormat.description: Segments gives timestamped lines, full text gives one transcript string, and both gives both plus SRT and WebVTT text and download links. SRT and WebVTT modes return the subtitle text and a signed download link.
outputFormat.title: Output format

postUrls.description: Post links or bare post IDs that contain a video or GIF. Accepts x.com and twitter.com links, /i/status and /i/web/status links, /video/N links, and bare numeric IDs. Profile links or usernames are accepted too and are treated like profile inputs. Provide this or Profile links — at least one of the two is required.
postUrls.title: Post links or IDs

profileUrls.description: Optional. Transcribe recent video posts from these profiles. Paste x.com profile links, @handles or bare usernames. Works without Post links.
profileUrls.title: Profile links or usernames

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use an Apify proxy if you plan large runs or see frequent rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

segmentGranularity.description: Level of the timestamped segments. Segment keeps the raw caption/Whisper cues. Sentence groups real word timings into sentences (or splits cue text, sharing the cue's real time range). Word emits one entry per real word timestamp and is used only when X captions or Whisper provide per-word timings — it is never fabricated; when word timings are missing, the row says so and keeps the raw segments.
segmentGranularity.title: Segment granularity

transcriptionMethod.description: Auto tries the video's built-in captions first and only falls back to Whisper AI when none exist. Captions-only skips videos without captions. AI-only always uses Whisper speech-to-text.
enumTitles: Auto — built-in captions first, AI fallback
Built-in captions only — skip videos without captions
AI (Whisper) only — always transcribe the audio
transcriptionMethod.title: How to transcribe

whisperModel.description: Whisper model used for AI transcription. Larger models are more accurate but slower and need more memory (medium and large-v2 need a run memory of at least 4096 MB and 8192 MB respectively). Base is a good balance for most videos. If the selected model does not fit the run memory, the actor automatically falls back to the next smaller model.
whisperModel.title: AI model size
